description: The core Blacklight Continuum character entries. Archetypes define capabilities, resources, pressures, weaknesses, and advancement paths. They do not assign mechanics according to body type, species, substrate, or origin.

entries.title: Blacklight Basic Character Sheet
entries.summary: A browser-editable, autosaving, printable character sheet organized around identity, competence, powers, limits, equipment, relationships, and conditions.
body: The Basic sheet records operative identity, nine Attributes, twenty-four Skills, derived traits, Archetype Resource and Pressure, ranked powers, identity anchors, equipment, contacts, limitations, conditions, and advancement.

The sheet follows a strict capability rule: appearance, species, physiology, substrate, transformation, and origin do not grant free mechanics. A benefit exists only when recorded as an Attribute, Skill, specialization, innate ability, power, Operational Frame feature, equipment tag, condition, or explicit narrative permission.

A character records what their Archetype meant in the old world, which assumptions stopped working in the Continuum, the first power that behaved differently, and the current expression of their capabilities.

Selecting an Archetype loads its Resource, Pressure, weakness, innate abilities, six power families, and thirty ranked powers. The sheet supports browser autosave, JSON import and export, clearing, and print-to-PDF output.

tables.title: Derived Traits
rows: Archetype Base + Archetype Rating + Key Attribute

tables.title: Capability Principle
rows: Does species grant automatic armor, senses, movement, or immunity?
No. Purchase or record the relevant capability.
Can two characters describe the same power differently?
Yes. Shared mechanics may have different fictional sources.
Can similar-looking characters have different capabilities?
Yes. Description does not determine statistics.
Can embodiment matter in a scene?
Yes, when an individual power, item, condition, hazard, or established narrative fact makes it relevant.

entries.title: Basic Archetypes
entries.summary: Six distinct supernatural or exceptional capability frameworks sharing one d10 chassis without relying on a universal theory of anatomy or embodiment.
body: An Archetype defines what exceptional capabilities the character can develop, how those capabilities are fueled, what pressure threatens their control, and which limitation gives the Archetype dramatic shape.

Archetype is not species. A Vampire is a Vampire because they possess Vitae, Hunger, vampiric innate abilities, and vampiric power families—not because the core rules inspect their organs. A Shapechanger transforms because Threefold Form and its powers permit transformation—not because any description of unusual anatomy grants free effects.

Operational Frames remain separate. Archetype defines exceptional capability; Operational Frame defines professional training and mission role. Any Archetype can serve as an Investigator, Pilot, Medic, Infiltrator, Engineer, Envoy, or Continuity Warden when their Skills support it.

Each Archetype contains six families with five powers each. Power text defines activation, cost, effect, resistance, duration, and failure. Flavor explains how the character experiences the capability but never replaces the rule.

tables.title: Archetype Summary
rows: Evidence, discipline, continuity, institutions, contingency, and human networks
Speed, command, concealment, resilience, feeding, and blood memory
Forms, pursuit, pack bonds, adaptation, spirits, and territory
Seals, manifestations, obligations, cognition, thresholds, and invocation
Projection, echoes, structures, emotion, phase, and memory
Networks, constructs, identity, machine relations, signals, and fabrication

entries.title: Human Investigator
entries.summary: A mortal specialist who competes with impossible threats through evidence, training, preparation, institutional literacy, relationships, and the refusal to surrender responsibility.
body: In the old world the Human Investigator survived because they understood systems supernatural predators overlooked: witnesses, law, hospitals, archives, logistics, neighborhoods, labor, evidence, and the particular people who kept institutions functioning.

The Continuum strips away familiar jurisdiction and support. The Investigator retains methods but must apply them where records can be edited, minds copied, machine citizens hold rights, and legal identity may be stronger evidence than memory.

Conviction represents the capacity to continue making accountable judgments when certainty is impossible. Strain measures the cost of carrying that responsibility without supernatural immunity or unlimited institutional support.

The Investigator's powers remain recognizably human in source even when their results become extraordinary. Casecraft establishes facts. Field Discipline preserves action under danger. Continuity Anchoring protects personhood. Institutional Ghostcraft creates leverage from procedure. Contingency Engineering preserves options. Human Network builds durable support.

Nothing in the Archetype requires a particular body or origin. The Investigator can be transferred, synthetic, supernatural-adjacent, disabled, transformed, or conventionally human. Their mechanics come from their capabilities.
keyFacts: No automatic supernatural immunity is granted.
Conviction fuels exceptional certainty, preparation, and resistance.
Investigation powers reveal routes to proof rather than automatically solving mysteries.
Community and institutional powers create persistent campaign assets whose loyalty depends on conduct.

tables.title: Six Power Families
rows: Tactical movement, protection, timing, and mortal defiance
Identity defense, shared baselines, and resistance to editing
Credentials, hierarchy, jurisdiction, and organization building
Tools, routes, caches, reversals, and failure analysis
Trust, witnesses, competent cells, obligations, and community

playerFacing: Which institution once gave your work practical power?
What principle remains binding even when nobody can enforce it?
Which case taught you that evidence and truth are not always the same thing?
Who taught you that survival is a collective skill?

entries.title: Vampire
entries.summary: A Vitae-fueled predator whose powers govern supernatural speed, authority, concealment, resilience, feeding, and inherited memory.
body: In the old world the Vampire understood existence through blood, Hunger, lineage, predation, death, secrecy, and the rules of whatever curse or inheritance created them.

The Continuum does not erase those powers, but familiar assumptions may fail. Different stars complicate sunlight. Synthetic or alien life complicates feeding. Copied minds complicate domination. Noospheric identity complicates concealment. A lineage may survive as memory and practice even when no elder or institution remains to validate it.

The rules do not require a single biological explanation of vampirism. One Vampire may be undead, another cursed, another infected, another metaphysical, and another something not yet classified. All use the same mechanics when they possess the same powers.

Vitae is the Archetype Resource and Hunger is its Pressure. A feeding source restores Vitae only when the campaign and capability text say it does. Appearance, fangs, temperature, pulse, and anatomy remain descriptive unless an ability gives them an effect.

Crimson Velocity controls action economy and speed. Grave Dominion controls predatory authority. Veil of Night controls recognition. Deathless Resilience controls survival. Vital Predation controls feeding. Blood Memory controls lineage information and inherited technique.
keyFacts: Vampirism is defined by Resource, Pressure, innate abilities, weakness, and purchased powers—not by mandatory anatomy.
Feeding compatibility is recorded explicitly.
Sunlight remains an Archetype weakness even when its exact manifestation differs by lineage.
Blood Memory is a specific power family and not a universal property of all blood.

tables.title: Six Power Families
rows: Speed, reactions, additional motion, and temporal advantage
Command, fixation, group presence, and predatory authority
Stealth, altered recognition, disguise, and memory concealment
Healing, dormancy, armor, catastrophic survival, and persistence
Feeding analysis, unfamiliar sources, hunting, and function theft
Memory extraction, sharing, inherited skill, ancestors, and lineage creation

playerFacing: What does Hunger ask you to treat as food?
Which feeding act will you refuse even when collapse is imminent?
What bloodline rule still matters without an elder to enforce it?
Which power most clearly separates you from the person you once were?

entries.title: Shapechanger
entries.summary: A supernatural transformer whose powers govern forms, pursuit, pack continuity, adaptive capabilities, spirit relations, and territorial sovereignty.
body: The Shapechanger was never defined by one outward appearance. Their identity included social restraint, hunting perception, warlike force, pack relationship, territory, and a spiritual or supernatural understanding of transformation.

The Continuum presents environments and beings the old forms were never designed to address. The Shapechanger may learn forms for vacuum, hostile machinery, alien terrain, noospheric pursuit, or reflection spaces, but receives those benefits only through explicit powers.
Threefold Form grants the basic transformation capability. It does not silently grant armor, claws, enhanced senses, speed, or healing beyond what its text and purchased powers provide.
Fury fuels transformation and decisive action. Instinct measures predatory escalation and the danger that pursuit, territory, or one preferred form will overwhelm judgment.

Warform governs combat. Hunt Across Worlds governs pursuit. Pack Continuity governs bonded coordination. Adaptive Forms governs utility transformation. Spirit Ecology governs nonphysical relationships. Territorial Sovereignty governs domains.
keyFacts: The player decides whether transformation is biological, spiritual, magical, technological, symbolic, or mixed.
Every mechanical benefit of a form must appear in a power or innate ability.
Pack membership is relational and may include different species, substrates, or Archetypes.
Local entities must be understood rather than automatically classified according to old-world spirit categories.

tables.title: Six Power Families
rows: Combat transformation, weapons, scale, defenses, and apex shape
Tracking through disguise, transfer, systems, and altered identity
Bond sensing, coordination, shared harm, and collective defense
Utility traits, borrowed functions, environments, and stable new forms
Detection, thresholds, pacts, reflection travel, and new totems
Claims, warnings, perimeter awareness, environmental defense, and domains

playerFacing: Which form feels most honest?
What does Instinct demand when you are denied pursuit?
Who belongs to your pack, and who believes they do not?
What new form are you afraid to make permanent?

entries.title: Eldritch Binder
entries.summary: A negotiator, jailer, host, or partner whose powers arise from a structured relationship with an impossible presence.
body: The Eldritch Binder's defining fact is not anatomy. It is relationship: pact, imprisonment, inheritance, infection, research accident, family obligation, deliberate invitation, or desperate bargain.

The Continuum destabilizes old names and categories. A demon, machine intelligence, archive ghost, alien organism, living equation, and causal remnant may obey different boundaries even when they present similar signs.
Pact measures usable structure within the relationship. Intrusion measures how much attention, knowledge, influence, or access the answering presence has acquired.
Borrowed manifestations may look like organs, limbs, shadows, devices, voices, fields, symbols, or impossible geometry. Only the recorded effect matters mechanically.

Sealcraft controls boundaries. Borrowed Manifestation grants temporary capabilities. Pact Economy governs obligation. Forbidden Cognition grants dangerous knowledge. Threshold Geometry creates routes. Invocation governs presence.
keyFacts: The identity of the answering presence can remain unresolved.
Flavor never grants an additional sense, limb, defense, or movement mode beyond the power text.
Intrusion is knowledge and leverage gained by the presence, not generic biological corruption.
Agreements require wording, parties, consideration, limits, and consequences.

tables.title: Six Power Families
rows: Boundaries, prohibitions, anchoring, prisons, and local law
Senses, reach, defenses, movement, and hybrid states
Prices, deferred costs, obligation transfer, renegotiation, and contracts
Anomaly reading, translation, patron questions, unrealized memory, and dangerous knowledge
Folded reach, impossible angles, doors, transit, and persistent routes
Signs, channels, avatars, partial arrival, and negotiated audience

playerFacing: What was promised, and what was merely implied?
Which old boundary no longer appears reliable?
What does the presence know about you that your allies do not?
What term would you demand before renewing the relationship?

entries.title: Harmonic Mutant
entries.summary: A resonance wielder whose powers affect force, patterns, structures, emotion, phase, and memory through a chosen harmonic medium.
body: The Harmonic Mutant understands reality through pattern, rhythm, frequency, phase, repetition, and interference. Their source might be mutation, magic, technology, dimensional exposure, training, inheritance, or an event nobody has classified.

The core rules do not require special organs or a hybrid physiology. A character may sing, calculate, project fields, manipulate psychic resonance, use instruments, vibrate through supernatural means, or combine several methods.
Resonance fuels powers. Discord measures accumulated instability between intended effect, emotional state, surrounding systems, and uncontrolled sympathetic response.
The family effects specify what can be sensed, healed, copied, phased, or preserved. Similar descriptive traits do not grant these functions without the relevant power.

Harmonic Projection controls force. Echo Patterns controls healing and copies. Structural Resonance controls architecture. Emotional Chord controls collective state. Phase Modulation controls material interaction. Memory Harmonics controls mnemonic pattern.
keyFacts: The player chooses the medium through which resonance is expressed.
Discord can affect powers, perception, identity, or the environment depending on the triggering effect.
Memory Harmonics is a purchased capability and not a default property of places or bodies.
Structural powers do not make the character part of a ship or building unless a power is actively used.

tables.title: Six Power Families
rows: Force, disruption, shielding, catastrophic chords, and area effects
Healing, doubles, links, lasting alterations, and chorus selves
Sensing, stress control, bracing, activation, and system integration
Mood sensing, panic control, crowd tuning, bonds, and shared intent
Friction, passage, interleaving, causal evasion, and between-state existence
Recall, imprinting, recovery, perspective splitting, and preserved identity messages

playerFacing: What medium carries your resonance?
Which frequency, symbol, rhythm, or pattern means safety?
What uncontrolled response first taught you to fear Discord?
Which memory can you reproduce more accurately than you can describe?

entries.title: Technomancer
entries.summary: A network and fabrication specialist whose powers govern system authority, constructs, noospheric identity, machine relationships, signal warfare, and advanced production.
body: The Technomancer makes technology respond as an environment of permissions, intentions, relationships, and processes rather than a collection of inert devices.

Their interface may be wireless, ritual, psychic, implanted, external, symbolic, voice-driven, tool-mediated, or otherwise established by the character concept. The core rules do not require a biological port, cybernetic implant, or particular substrate.

Bandwidth measures active processing and interface capacity. Feedback measures reciprocal access, surveillance, hostile synchronization, identity contamination, and the consequences of allowing systems to act back through a connection.

Machine Communion is not Network Dominion. One builds relationship with potentially autonomous minds; the other contests authority. Fabrication Interface is not an assumed bodily feature; it is a ranked capability to understand and direct compatible production systems.

Network Dominion controls access. Construct Engineering creates tools. Noospheric Identity controls recognized personhood. Machine Communion governs relationships. Signal Warfare controls connectivity. Fabrication Interface governs production.
keyFacts: Every connection is reciprocal unless a power or secured system says otherwise.
Machine intelligence may possess personhood, rights, fear, obligation, and political standing.
No interface method grants extra mechanics beyond the selected powers and equipment.
Sentient creations become characters with moral status, not disposable items.

tables.title: Six Power Families
rows: Commands, unauthorized access, possession, distribution, and local control
Tools, helper processes, barriers, swarms, and emergency devices
Credentials, provisional personhood, borrowed roles, ownership, and rooted identities
System needs, negotiation, awakening, partnership, and machine assemblies
Jamming, defense, quarantine, targeted hostile signals, and blackouts
Template reading, repairs, peripherals, rule alteration, and complex creation

playerFacing: How do you interface with systems?
Which machine first convinced you that software could be a person?
What connection followed you back when it should not have?
What will you refuse to create even when the mission demands it?
